shortDescription: FIREX (Emirates Fire Fighting Equipment Factory LLC) is a UAE manufacturer and supplier of firefighting and safety equipment.
whatTheyDo: FIREX manufactures and distributes firefighting equipment including fire extinguishers, fire pumps, suppression systems, alarms, and emergency vehicles. It provides fire safety installation and maintenance services for commercial, industrial, and residential projects.
notes: Input specified Al Quoz, Dubai, but FIREX (Emirates Fire Fighting Equipment Factory LLC) has its primary headquarters and manufacturing in Industrial Area 13, Sharjah, with a Dubai branch office in Umm Ramool; no facility was found in Al Quoz.

shortDescription: First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) is the largest bank in the UAE, formed by the merger of First Gulf Bank and National Bank of Abu Dhabi.
whatTheyDo: FAB provides corporate, commercial, retail, and investment banking services across the UAE and globally. Its operations encompass consumer banking, corporate finance, global transaction banking, and digital banking platforms.
address: FAB Building, Khalifa Business Park, Al Qurm District, Abu Dhabi, UAE

shortDescription: First Security Group is a Dubai-based security services, guarding, and facilities management provider.
whatTheyDo: First Security Group provides physical security guarding, surveillance operations, SIRA-certified security training, risk consultancy, and facility management services. Established by retired Dubai Police officials, it supports government, hospitality, and corporate institutions.
address: First Security Group Building, Dubai Academic City, Al Rowaiyah Second, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed Downtown Dubai, but the company's verified headquarters is located in Dubai International Academic City (Al Rowaiyah Second).

shortDescription: FIVE Hotels and Resorts is a Dubai-based luxury lifestyle and hospitality group.
whatTheyDo: FIVE Hotels and Resorts develops and manages entertainment and lifestyle hospitality venues including FIVE Palm Jumeirah, FIVE Jumeirah Village, and FIVE LUXE JBR. Its operations span luxury guest accommodations, fine dining restaurants, nightlife venues, and beach clubs.
address: FIVE Palm Jumeirah, No. 1 Palm Jumeirah, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed Business Bay, but the corporate headquarters and flagship property are located at FIVE Palm Jumeirah.

shortDescription: FLC Marketing Group is an integrated shopper marketing and experiential brand activation agency in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: FLC Marketing Group delivers consumer engagement, experiential brand activations, retail shopper marketing, event staging, influencer campaigns, and digital content production. It serves regional and multinational consumer goods and technology brands across the GCC.
address: Grosvenor Business Tower, Barsha Heights, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed JLT, but the company's verified primary office is located in Grosvenor Business Tower, Barsha Heights (TECOM).

shortDescription: flydubai is the government-owned low-cost carrier of Dubai, operating scheduled flights across the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and Europe.
whatTheyDo: flydubai operates scheduled commercial air transport services from Dubai International Airport utilizing a fleet of Boeing 737 aircraft. Its technical divisions manage flight operations, aircraft maintenance engineering, flight dispatch, crew training, and route planning across more than 100 destinations.
address: flydubai Headquarters, Dubai International Airport, Terminal 2, Dubai, UAE
notes: flydubai operates corporate headquarters at Terminal 2 of Dubai International Airport, along with a flight training campus at Al Warsan 3.

shortDescription: Food Quest Restaurants Management LLC is an F&B restaurant operator and franchise investor based in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: Food Quest develops, operates, and franchises quick-service, casual, and premium dining concepts in the UAE and wider GCC. Its restaurant portfolio includes ALBAIK in the UAE, Denny's, and upscale dining brands managed under its Leisure Quest division.
address: Office 302-B, 3rd Floor, Sama Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed Downtown Dubai; the head office is located in Sama Tower on Sheikh Zayed Road (Trade Centre area).

shortDescription: Ford Middle East is the regional subsidiary of Ford Motor Company directing vehicle distribution and operations in the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: Ford Middle East oversees regional marketing, vehicle distribution, customer support, parts supply, and dealership operations for Ford and Lincoln brands. It runs regional sales and technical service support across the Middle East.
address: Iris Bay Tower, Al Mustaqbal Street, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE
notes: Sales office located in Iris Bay Tower, Business Bay; additional corporate facilities situated on Sheikh Zayed Road and training center in JAFZA.

shortDescription: G4S International Logistics was the secure transport and commodity logistics division of G4S operating in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: G4S International Logistics provided secure cross-border transportation, storage, and vaulting services for high-value commodities such as precious metals, diamonds, and artwork. In the UAE, G4S continues to operate security management, cash and courier solutions, and workforce support.
address: Almas Tower, Jumeirah Lakes Towers (JLT), Dubai, UAE
notes: G4S International Logistics (G4Si) historically operated high-value transport and vault pickup services at Almas Tower, JLT and DAFZA. The global G4Si business was acquired by Brink's in 2020, while G4S plc was acquired by Allied Universal in 2021.

shortDescription: Galadari Brothers Group is a multi-industry conglomerate operating across automotive, media, engineering, and F&B in the UAE.
whatTheyDo: Galadari Brothers Group operates business units spanning automotive retail (Mazda distributor), news publishing (Khaleej Times), ice cream and restaurant franchising (Baskin-Robbins), heavy construction equipment, and industrial engineering services across the UAE and international markets.
address: Khaleej Times Building, 14 Latifa Bint Hamdan Street, Al Quoz First Industrial Area, PO Box 138, Dubai, UAE
notes: Input listed Dubai Internet City, where the group owns the Galadari Building commercial property; the corporate headquarters is situated in the Khaleej Times Building in Al Quoz First Industrial Area.
